I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. The reply confirms the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats. He said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team, because that's where the wrong number went out this morning. I didn't open #central-team or post there myself. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in this channel.
